newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - July 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - July 30.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The European Union has banned the entry of Bangladeshi shrimps to its member countries, shrimp exporters said.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina will visit Indonesia and the Philippines in September to boost trade ties with the southeast Asian countries.
Leading trade unions enforce a 24-hour countrywide strike on Wednesday to press their demands for higher wages and halt to the government's denationalisation programme.
Dhaka has protested against the decision of the European Union to slap ban on Bangladeshi shrimps.
Opposition leader Begum Khaleda Zia on Tuesday said her Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) was under pressure from people to launch a vigorous anti-government agitation.
Bangladesh has planned to create 23 million new jobs in next five year.
Finance Minister S.A.M.S. Kibria said the Value Added Tax net needed to be expanded.
A new container terminal will be built in the Chittagong Port. REUTER
